text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —The day of the Hanshin Juvenile Fillies.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Now then, I wonder what kind of new 
heroine will emerge from this year's 
Hanshin JF...!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Aww, I didn't make it in time to see the 
famous Daiichi Ruby. I really wanted to 
see her run.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
...The time has finally come, Ikuno-san. 
May fortune be with you on the 
battlefield—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: "—We've finally arrived. At the GⅠ stage."
choice_data_list: Yeah, the time has finally come...!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
To be honest... I'm having more trouble 
controlling my nerves and excitement than 
ever before.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
So this is... the atmosphere of a GⅠ 
race...—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
There is definitely a lingering tension in 
Ikuno Dictus's expression. At this rate, 
it might even affect her running...!
choice_data_list:
...Come on, let's just be honest and 
celebrate!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Stepping onto the track of a GⅠ race... 
That is a privilege granted only to the 
chosen Umamusume."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Because Ikuno Dictus fought tooth and 
nail through this Junior year, she was 
able to seize... undeniable glory."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Precisely because it's right before the 
race, I need to take this fact to heart 
once more and turn it into confidence for 
today...!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Be genuinely happy...

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Yaaaaay!!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
......Um. Those are my honest feelings, 
but—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: It's a GⅠ—!!!!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Yaaaaaaay!!!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, Ikuno Dictus and I let our 
emotions take over, shouting with joy for 
a while—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Phew—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
...I feel so much better now. Thank you, 
Trainer.
choice_data_list: What a wonderful display of joy that was!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"I took a page from how my friend 
expresses her joy. Speaking one's feelings 
aloud so honestly is, I must admit, quite 
refreshing."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seems Ikuno Dictus was able to ease her 
tension just the right amount...!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: —Excuse me. Someone is calling...—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
...Speak of the devil. It's from that 
friend. May I answer it?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Thank you very much. Well then—

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: "IKUNOOOOOO!!!"

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Good luck in your race! Who cares if it's 
a GⅠ! Blow them all away--!!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"Turbo-san... Thank you so much for going 
out of your way to come."

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
I'm here too~! Congrats on running in a 
GⅠ, Ikuno!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
I'll be cheering for you from the Academy 
so you can give it your absolute all! 
You've got this~!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"Fufu. Thank you very much. I will 
definitely give it my absolute all."

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Man, we've really run all the way up to 
such a dazzling place, haven't we, 
Ikuno-san?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
It feels presumptuous of me to say 
anything, but... ...Well, don't strain 
yourself too hard. Good luck.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Natureee~, put on a cheerleader outfit and 
cheer them on~. Like, "Go, fight, win!"

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Where did this come from all of a sudden?! 
And why cheerleaders?! Besides, how is 
that supposed to cheer Ikuno on—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"I would certainly love to. It sounds very 
encouraging."

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Hey, don't play along, don't play along!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
—Sheesh, you seem a lot calmer than I 
expected.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Yes. Thanks to you.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
With everyone's cheers in my heart... I 
will run towards victory.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
"That's the spirit!! Go get 'em, Ikuno! 
You can do it, Ikunooo!!"

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: ――Well then, I'm off.
choice_data_list:
Let's make this the grand finale of the 
junior division!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"I will make it happen, without fail. 
Please look forward to it."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (――WAAAAAAAHHH!!!)

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
(...A sharp, stinging tension in the air. 
So this is a GⅠ paddock...)

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Still, it's alright.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
(What dwells within me is burning. I can 
feel it so vividly, so—)

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
――Let us begin anew from here. The long 
trail of my hoofprints.
